name: Kai Bruno
life: “I still remember a whole rehearsal run for the adult who usually locked the hall.” People around the corner by Juniper Tailor know Kai by a small Thursday habit. Kai looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I was the stage manager who almost canceled. My own parents missed all my shows and I wanted this one ordinary person to get in.
appearance: Kai has a center part and straight chestnut hair, a narrow face with an expressive upper lip, and a favorite piece of clothing, a cream pullover. It usually goes with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it. When somebody else has the floor, Kai squares up pieces of paper while thinking.
personality: Kai is cheerful on a bad morning and unexpectedly melancholy after a success. Finishing a hard thing means losing the daily company of the people who worked on it.
agenda: To keep the room open for one working audience member.
family: Sara Hall is Kai’s stepsibling. Kai gets to change the plan. Sara offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The soft wharf chalk*, Sara says, “The dates put my dad here months after he supposedly left town.”
connections: Yusuf Solis. The student villain and the stage manager both have memories riding on a parent getting into the room.

reactions.response: Kai checks who can actually stay and which ride home would be lost.
